note: Montana FWP Fishing Access Site on the Madison River just north-east of Ennis: from Hwy 287 at milepost 48 (0.25 mi south of Ennis) turn onto Jeffers Road, then 2 mi north. Primitive campsites with gravel boat ramp and toilet. --Claude
summary: FWP's FishMT page confirms the 25-ft trailer limit, 7-day stay limit, and the $12 (with fishing license) / $18 (without) camping fee already recorded; lists a toilet, primitive campsites and a gravel ramp. Not stated: how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived none left), site count. Note: directions corrected (the site is 2 mi north on Jeffers Rd, not on Hwy 287 south of Ennis) and restated values trimmed.
